name: dsh-minato-bridge
description: NOT the toolkit - this manifest exists only so the repository can be installed as a plugin by URL. It is an optional READ-ONLY bridge that publishes dsh in-process session/token state as one small JSON snapshot for the standalone DeepSeek Harness Toolkit (dsh-minato). Install the toolkit first: https://github.com/sakanamaru/dsh-minato - this plugin alone does nothing useful. No model calls, no network, no writes to dsh state.
